problemTitle: School Result Processing and GPA Engine

techStack.frontend: Next.js 16+ (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Lucide Icons, Archivo Google Font
techStack.backend: Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, Zod
techStack.testing: Vitest, Supertest, Custom Deterministic Rule Audit Suite

rulesImplemented: R-11: Component pass marks (Theory >= 25/75, Practical >= 8/25, Theory-only >= 33/100; failing either fails subject with 0 GP)
R-12: Absence handling (Compulsory AB gives 0 GP and overall F; Optional AB gives 0 contribution and flags for checking)
R-13: Optional contribution max(0, GP - 2), GPA divided by 6, capped at 5.00, compulsory failure override to 0.00/F with preserved uncancelled GPA
R-29: Office checking lists for Optional Review (GP <= 2 or AB), Practical Fail (< 8), and Absent (AB) with multi-list support
